```{ojs}
import {
  atlasCitation,
  atlasContributionSection,
  resolveContributors,
} from "/helpers/citation.js";

{
  const directory =
    await FileAttachment("/data/shared/contributors.json").json();
  return atlasContributionSection(
    resolveContributors(notebookConfig.contributors, directory),
    atlasCitation(nbTitle),
    language.key,
  );
}
```
